public_rationale: On September 30, 2025, Crusoe reported that Abilene's first two buildings had been energized [e1]. On June 9, 2026, it reported two operational buildings and six under construction [e2]. Neither disclosure establishes completion of an identified in-scope facility or contracted phase while the publication-date construction rate persisted [e1; e2]. These disclosures do not establish a qualifying early completion [e1; e2].
limitations: The covered project set and the relevant unit of completion are not fixed.
The disclosures do not establish the publication-date construction rate or its continuation [e1; e2].
Partial operation does not establish whole-campus completion [e1; e2].
The contract's December 31, 2029 deadline remains in the future at the October 28, 2026 evaluation.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: At the current rate, data centers in the announced multi-billion dollar compute deals will not be built before 2030.

statement.excerpt: Simple questions like “where are the GPUs going?” and “how many actual GPUs have been installed?” are left unanswered as article after article gets written about massive, multi-billion dollar compute deals for data centers that won’t be built before, at this rate, 2030.
statement.document_title: The AI Industry Is Lying To You

from_speaker: data centers that won’t be built before
our_interpretation: Assess the construction forecast, rather than the separate complaint about unanswered GPU questions.
The latest day before 2030 is December 31, 2029.
The relevant projects are those underlying the large compute deals discussed by the post, not every data center worldwide.
Treat at this rate as a condition requiring evidence that the relevant construction pace persisted.
Built ordinarily means completion of the relevant facility or contracted phase; an operating portion does not necessarily establish completion of an entire campus.
criteria.support_condition: For an identified project set whose referenced construction pace persisted, the relevant facilities or phases remain incomplete through December 31, 2029.
criteria.contradiction_condition: An identified in-scope facility or contracted phase is completed before January 1, 2030 while the stated construction-rate condition holds.

evidence.explanation: Initial buildings had been energized before the post. This is material against an expansive reading, but it is neither a post-publication completion event nor proof that the entire campus was finished.

evidence.locator: Portfolio paragraph immediately before 'A Pipeline to Power the Next Era of AI'
evidence.explanation: The same paragraph distinguishes operational buildings from additional buildings under construction at Abilene. The update does not define the forecast's project set or demonstrate persistence of its baseline pace.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Identify the covered projects, the relevant unit of completion and the publication-date construction rate. Establish whether that rate persisted, then document either a qualifying completion before January 1, 2030 or continued incompletion of the covered facilities or phases through December 31, 2029.
